title: Koh Samet, salvaged: The Lost Fireflies
checkIn: ship: the whole trip rebuilt on one story
kaylee: The gecko fire dancers lost their four fireflies in last night's wind. She taps a beach's picture, the taxi takes her straight there, she plays its game and its firefly comes home with her. With all four, the fireflies light up the fire show she twirls in.
